Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 5, Verse 11

“Yogins perform action with the body, the mind, the understanding, or even with the senses alone, abandoning attachment, for the purification of the self.”

Note the purpose given: atma-shuddhi, self-purification. The work is not being done for the world's sake here, but because doing it cleanly changes the one who does it.
